verdict.rationale: Jira's docs describe breaking work into actionable tasks and assigning them to the right person (jira-docs-10, jira-docs-23), and calendar and timeline views imply date-based scheduling (jira-docs-11). Community users confirm that ticket creation and assignment work in practice (jira-comm-7, jira-comm-8, jira-comm-11), though one notes an issue can only have a single assignee (jira-comm-2). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of due-date fields on tasks, multi-assignee support, and in-depth first-party docs on the task-creation flow.
